/.title: Designer & Luxury Cane Furniture | Vaidehi Craft
/.description: Vaidehi Craft is a home for designer cane furniture and quality artefacts, handcrafted since 1998. Our bespoke cane furniture, from sofas, chairs and swings to tables, brings the warmth of natural cane together with modern design. Each branded, luxury piece is made with skilled artisans and sustainable materials for homes, offices and commercial spaces. Cane is not bamboo: it is a material that bends into elegant, timeless forms. Explore the collection and create a space that feels truly yours.
